title: Panshi world fact manifest historical v1
description: WorldFactManifestHistoricalV1: the sealed envelope for one historical-mode market session. This is the separate contractVersion/modeDomain pair that ../v1/schema.json points at when it says "Historical-mode manifests are a separate contractVersion/modeDomain pair, not this schema". Unlike the current-mode contract, a historical-mode manifest in this repo is NOT consumed from the upstream market-research repository: it is a repo-owned synthetic fixture, which is why every historical manifest carries provenanceClass "synthetic_fixture" and truthClass "fictional_setting" and may never be labelled real_fact. Top-level field set and required list are otherwise exactly the current-mode WorldFactManifestV1 shape from docs/v5/system-design.md §6.2. The manifest itself only carries revision ID allowlists; the referenced fact revision records live in the sibling fact-revision.schema.json.

modeDomain.description: This contract only covers historical-mode (replayed, already-closed session) manifests. The current-mode manifest is ../v1/schema.json.

provenanceClass.description: Where this manifest's facts come from. A historical-mode manifest in this repository is generated inside this repository as a self-contained fixture; it never mirrors a licensed upstream market feed, so this is the only permitted value. See README.md §Why synthetic, never real_fact.

truthClass.description: The single truth_class every claim sealed by this manifest carries (docs/v5/product-constitution.md 「角色資料的五種身分」). Synthetic prices are fictional setting, not 真實資料; labelling them real_fact would be a false claim, so real_fact is unrepresentable in this contract.

manifestId.description: Immutable identifier of this sealed manifest.

manifestHash.description: SHA-256 of the RFC 8785 JCS canonical UTF-8 bytes of this manifest object with the manifestHash and objectHash fields removed. Same convention as ../v1; see README.md §Digest convention.

signatureKeyId.description: Identifier of the key that sealed this manifest. Never a secret value, only a key reference.

sealedAt.description: When this manifest was sealed. Not a world-time boundary by itself.

marketSessionId.description: Historical-mode sessions live in this repository's own synthetic session namespace (the same namespace as the canonical event fixtures' session-v5-golden-001), not the upstream mkts_ namespace the current-mode contract references.

marketDateTaipei.description: Asia/Taipei market calendar day, matching the sealed-facts v1 market_date_taipei convention.

marketCalendarRevision.description: Which calendar revision decided this session's trading days. Historical-mode fixtures use a contract-style versioned identifier, so this pattern additionally permits "/".

interactionCutoffAt.description: Upper bound for interaction (exposure/attention/appraisal/action) eligibility: available_at <= min(character_world_time, interactionCutoffAt, CognitionInputSealed.occurred_at). In historical mode this is the session open, so a fact first available intraday in session S only becomes interaction-eligible from session S+1's manifest.

evidenceCutoffAt.description: Upper bound for outcome/editorial evidence eligibility: available_at <= evidenceCutoffAt. Independent of interactionCutoffAt — neither substitutes for the other.

licenseClass.description: Opaque, ingest-time gate value. A synthetic historical fixture carries no third-party licence, which the value itself must make explicit.

rightsValidFrom.description: Ingest/bind gate only. Never substitutes for world time (system-design.md §6.2).

rightsValidUntil.description: Null means open-ended rights validity. Ingest/bind gate only, same caveat as rightsValidFrom.

interactionFactRevisionIds.description: Physically separate allowlist. May ONLY be used for exposure/attention/appraisal/action. A fact revision id may also appear in outcomeEvidenceRevisionIds, but each pipeline must resolve it through its own list's explicit ref — this is not one list reused.

interactionFactSetDigest.description: Digest over interactionFactRevisionIds. See README.md §Digest convention.

outcomeEvidenceRevisionIds.description: Physically separate allowlist. May ONLY be used for paper outcome, correction, and post-close editorial. Empty for a session whose MarketSessionFinality has not been accepted — the fence is an absent allowlist entry, never a nulled placeholder.

outcomeEvidenceSetDigest.description: Digest over outcomeEvidenceRevisionIds. See README.md §Digest convention.

objectUri.description: Location of the mirrored fact-revision bundle slice this manifest seals. Historical-mode fixtures are repo-owned, so this is an authority-less panshi-fixture: URI whose opaque path is a repository-relative path and whose fragment is this manifest's id. It must never contain a host component.

objectHash.description: SHA-256 of the RFC 8785 JCS canonical UTF-8 bytes of this manifest's slice of the mirrored fact-revision bundle at objectUri. See README.md §Digest convention.
